_about: 2-Butanone (1) + Ethanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-butanone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Wen, C.-C.[Chao-Cheng], Tu, C. -H.[Chein-Hsiun], Vapor liquid equilibria for binary and ternary mixtures of ethanol, 2-butanone, and 2,2,4-trimethylpentane at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 258 (2007) 131-139
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 9. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0030. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.25 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
